intro: I have taught for more than fifteen years, first GIS and remote sensing at Ambo University in Ethiopia and now soil science at the University of Florida.

roles.title: Instructor, SWS3022L Introduction to Soils in the Environment Laboratory
roles.detail: Teach two undergraduate lab sections on soil physical and chemical properties, field sampling, lab measurement, and data interpretation. Mentor a PhD student in supervised teaching.

roles.title: Teaching assistant, SWS5132 Tropical Soil Management
roles.detail: Spring and fall 2025, including an online course offered jointly by UF and partners in Brazil.

roles.title: Teaching assistant, SWS4207/5208 Sustainable Agricultural and Urban Land Management
Assistant Professor of Geoinformation
roles.detail: Graduate and undergraduate courses in GIS, remote sensing, spatial modeling, land administration, and environmental monitoring. Supervised MSc theses.

roles.title: Lecturer, Geospatial Science and Natural Resources
roles.detail: Core courses in GIS, remote sensing, hydrological modeling, and cartography. Supervised senior theses and student research.
